name: ableton-sdk-mcp
description: MCP control plane for Ableton Live: stdio MCP server (Claude Code side) + WebSocket kernel extension (Live side) exposing the sound-intent engine.

scripts.setup: npm --prefix kernel install && npm --prefix abletonsdk-mcp-server install
scripts.typecheck: npm --prefix kernel run typecheck && npm --prefix abletonsdk-mcp-server run typecheck
scripts.test: npm --prefix kernel test && npm --prefix abletonsdk-mcp-server test
